question: Summarise OC 115F, covering the requirements across its sections.
answer_claims: [{"text": "Circular OC 115F serves as an addendum to circular NPCI/UPI/OC-115E/2024-25 regarding the resolution of Numeric UPI IDs.", "sources": ["S1"], "draft_index": 1, "support_status": "automated_supported"}, {"text": "Banks, PSPs, and UPI Applications must utilize the Mobile Number Revocation List (MNRL) on the Digital Intelligence platform to update their databases regularly.", "sources": ["S3"], "draft_index": 2, "support_status": "automated_supported"}, {"text": "The liability for any omission, delay, or dispute arising from failure to update the Numeric UPI ID Mapper rests with the PSP and the UPI Application.", "sources": ["S3"], "draft_index": 3, "support_status": "automated_supported"}, {"text": "Payer PSPs and UPI Applications must route mobile number-based transactions through the Numeric UPI ID Mapper, except when response time exceeds one second, in which case local resolution is permitted but liability remains with the respective PSP and UPI Application.", "sources": ["S5"], "draft_index": 4, "support_status": "automated_supported"}, {"text": "In the interim before a separate Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) is issued for user complaints regarding non-updation of UPI ID Mapper Number transactions, Remitter Banks must investigate complaints after verifying specific conditions.", "sources": ["S2"], "draft_index": 5, "support_status": "automated_supported"}, {"text": "The verification conditions for Remitter Banks include confirming the transaction used the Numeric UPI ID Mapper, checking if the beneficiary mobile number was present in MNRL records prior to the transaction, and determining if the Beneficiary Bank represented or rejected the chargeback request.", "sources": ["S4"], "draft_index": 6, "support_status": "automated_supported"}]
